name: .github
boundary: Approved community/workflow surfaces and package-level evidence checks.
first_witness: An inherited workflow actually rejects a seeded failure; public links/metadata remain truthful.
design_focus: Canonical policy sources, generated publication and rule-change scope.

name: AgilePlus
boundary: Actual repository-scoped transitions, permissions, engine receipts and corresponding UI.
first_witness: Use host-native action to create/review a scoped work item; restart; reject wrong-root and unauthorized changes.
design_focus: Flow mockups and state variants for conflict, validation, offline and recovery. Do not credit changed generated files as an engine transition.

name: BytePort
boundary: Real deploy/inspect/update/rollback, integrating shared supervision without a second app UI.
first_witness: Operate one real target through the installed client; verify service state and host pixels plus failed readiness recovery.
design_focus: Deployment progression, error/partial states, credential boundaries and destructive confirmations.

name: CivicWarfare
profile_proposal: owned mod plus gray/black host game
boundary: Actual installed mod gameplay, HUD, assets, save state and compatibility.
first_witness: User-path onboarding/combat or economy action with visible feedback and save/reload; known missing HUD/asset must fail.
design_focus: State-specific HUD, onboarding, feedback, contextual controls and limitations of unavailable host internals.

name: Civis
boundary: Real player build and renderer plus controlled world/state probes and API.
first_witness: Create/populate world; act via player input; verify state and subtle visible feature; save/reopen; negative render and input controls.
design_focus: Game-first cameras/modes, god/leader/individual flows, placement/selection/HUD, living-world continuation and shipping asset profile.

name: Dino
profile_proposal: gray-box mod bridge and external capture
boundary: Reuse GameControlCli/named-pipe bridge; pair permitted state hooks with actual host-game input and capture.
first_witness: Distinctive pack change -> real user action -> stat/combat effect -> visible pixels -> save/reload. An initialization log alone fails.
design_focus: Pack/install/menu/gameplay and scene-transition flows; required asset, main-thread and overlay behavior.

name: HeliosCLI
profile_proposal: owned fork CLI plus native shell
boundary: Actual installed agent binary, PTY state, tools, sessions and provider failures.
first_witness: Execute bounded coding task through actual CLI; cancel/resume; preserve permission boundaries; VHS/transcript evidence.
design_focus: Terminal states, prompts, JSON output contract, interruptions and source-fork identity.

name: HeliosLab
profile_proposal: owned native/web UI and scoped services
boundary: Establish correct product surface then automate real navigation and its authoritative actions.
first_witness: One useful workbench/config task through actual UI with keyboard, error, save/restart and constrained permissions.
design_focus: Canonical flow avoids implementing a different product merely because its packages compile.

name: HeliosLite
boundary: User PTY, tool invocation, reconnect/state and child process behavior.
first_witness: Real task with stream interruption and non-idempotent-tool boundary; no duplicate action after recovery.
design_focus: Transcript/terminal UX, session/history controls and actual machine-readable interface.

name: KCode
boundary: Foreground/user actions, child-runner state, compaction, retry and operation identity.
first_witness: Interrupted long task resumes on the intended artifact/workspace without repeating side effects or false completion.
design_focus: Idle/error/busy semantics, permission prompts and capability contribution to other hosts.

name: Khostty
boundary: Final terminal pixels, PTY bytes, native input/IME/accessibility and owned patch behavior.
first_witness: Unicode, resize/reflow, alternate-screen and input sequences on actual native build; tiny glyph clipping and wrong window fail.
design_focus: Typography, native chrome, focus, shortcuts and support-profile render differences.

name: KooshaPari
boundary: Real deployed links, claims, downloads, source identities and responsive/accessibility behavior.
first_witness: A new visitor reaches and installs one current product from the actual page; broken/stale/private link fails.
design_focus: Approved portfolio content, navigation, mobile/reduced-motion and download/version states.

name: Melosviz
boundary: Live supported renderer, audio/timing, actual output frames and authoring interactions.
first_witness: Import real media, edit, render/export, reopen and recover; placeholders may qualify pipeline-only scope, never live-render scope.
design_focus: Timeline, previews, provider status, render/error/recovery, motion/audio and authored scene sources.

name: OmniRoute
boundary: Real provider transport and host-native routing operations, independent of dashboard rendering.
first_witness: Select provider through actual UI/API, stream/cancel, reconcile quota and error; qualify failover without duplicate billable operations.
design_focus: Provider setup, scope/credentials, errors and truthful runtime metrics; synthetic responses never masquerade as live.

name: PhenoApps
boundary: Per-app source/build/state boundaries with one collection owner, not one averaged application grade.
first_witness: Choose one app, capture its complete useful flow and preserve unrelated apps; per-app role-specific grades.
design_focus: Separate mockup/flow/data contracts for each app; shared assets/components keep one authority.

name: PhenoDesign
boundary: Canonical tokens, editable source assets, tested components and actual downstream renderings.
first_witness: Change one shared design component and inspect at least two real consumers under relevant states.
design_focus: Source/preview/review/version linkage, licensed assets, accessibility and reduced-motion behavior.

name: PhenoFabric
boundary: Zero-UI capability contribution plus actual two-node input/output with scope and clock correlation.
first_witness: Invoke a host feature backed by a real peer; verify state/output/recovery, no focus theft and no silent provider swap.
design_focus: Multi-device discovery, permission/error states, focus ownership and real endpoint presentation.

name: PhenoLab
boundary: Actual benchmark runners, native outputs and negative-oracle behavior.
first_witness: Run known-good and known-bad candidates; malformed/missing state or skipped implementation cannot pass.
design_focus: Reproducible experiment design, error classification and trustworthy grader report views.

name: PhenoRegistry
boundary: Stable product identity and curated roles, with source-bound runtime/package evidence links.
first_witness: Rename fixture keeps identity; stale/contradictory roles and inaccessible evidence remain explicit.
design_focus: Inspectable authority/status views; no invented portfolio approvals or duplicated engine state.

name: PhenoShared
boundary: Reusable protocols/adapters/engine helpers/grader machinery with per-package real consumers.
first_witness: One shared capability consumed by two products without source copies; pin semantics and negative consumer contracts.
design_focus: Document ports and lifecycle; do not force a universal GUI or score unreachable packages as verified.

name: Portage
boundary: Real environment/task execution, reward/scorer contracts and deterministic record ingestion.
first_witness: Direct upstream/fork matched task with known pass/fail/environment error; imported timestamps are not new evidence.
design_focus: Task/environment/run lifecycle, portable report schemas and install/use transcript.

name: ShareCLI
boundary: Real process control, resource behavior, machine API, input/notifications and shared consumers.
first_witness: Cancel/restart supervised jobs under foreground load; wrong workspace/no-op and unsafe coalescing fail.
design_focus: Stateful supervisor views, CLI contracts, tray/focus rules and per-consumer integration.

name: Tracera
boundary: Persistent intent/design/source/quality graph, meaningful dissatisfied-capability detection and numerical views.
first_witness: Import a real subject; expose known semantic/visual gap; navigate its evidence; update and restart without fabricated state.
design_focus: Inspectable thought-to-runtime model, unresolved alternatives, canonical previews and grade rationale with exact scope.

name: WorldSphereMod
profile_proposal: gray-box mod plus black host rendering
boundary: Actual mod artifact/host version, external camera/input, final pixels and permitted state probes.
first_witness: Exercise seam/LOD/terrain-color/animation with orbit and movement; small known-bad defect fails even if global similarity stays high.
design_focus: Camera/shape/render profiles, supported assets, loading/enable/disable and save compatibility.
